pick_curve.note: Realised value over a drafted player's first four seasons (points above replacement, discounted 10% a season, seasons below replacement count zero), offensive linemen and long snappers excluded; picks from the 2008-2022 drafts. Draft slots: the NFL's draft data via nflverse's players release (from 2008; earlier slots there come from Pro Football Reference, whose terms forbid this use).

notes.source: Transactions: ESPN's public NFL transactions list (club notes as published), parsed by us.
notes.left_out: Not used, for their terms: nflverse's trades table and draft-pick table (both from Pro Football Reference, whose terms forbid building websites or tools on its data) and contract figures (OverTheCap's terms).
notes.method: Value at the time: the player's projection from the seasons completed before the trade (rest of that season and the next three, discounted 10% a season), picks from our draft-pick value curve. Realised: the player's value above replacement per game times the games played for the new club since. Now: realised plus what is still projected while the player is on that roster. Picks keep their curve value: our sources do not say which player a traded pick became.
notes.parse: Trades are parsed from the clubs' notes as ESPN publishes them; a note that names no player we can match, or a club we cannot identify, is shown with what could be read.
